newsitem.title: GERMANY: MG plans legal action over AGIV allegation.
newsitem.headline: MG plans legal action over AGIV allegation.

text.p: Metallgesellschaft AG (MG) plans to take legal action against industrial holding company AGIV AG after AGIV accused it of breach of confidentiality, sources close to MG said on Friday.

MG had announced on Thursday it had decided not to buy a 49.99 percent stake in AGIV. That announcement was a response to AGIV's move on Wednesday to halt the due diligence process associated with the planned purchase by MG of the stake, which is held by BHF-Bank AG.
AGIV's management had accused MG of leaking confidential data about AGIV that had come to light in the course of the due diligence examination.
MG would use legal means to react "in clear terms," sources at MG said.
MG also rejected a claim by AGIV management board chairman Udo Stark that MG had given a guarantee that AGIV would remain intact within the MG group.
